description: Corrections to what AWS's Service Authorization Reference says these operations are authorized as, where a live call disagrees (scripts/iam.ts). Each `reason` is the evidence.

value.reason: AWS lists it for the operation, but the RDS Bindings suite calls it successfully without it.
Needed only when the request names a DBSnapshotIdentifier (a snapshot taken on stop).

conditional.rds:AddTagsToResource: Needed only when the request names a DBSnapshotIdentifier (a snapshot taken on stop).
conditional.rds:CreateDBSnapshot: Needed only when the request names a DBSnapshotIdentifier (a snapshot taken on stop).
